paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Ada. See the entry Rav Shmuel bar Idi.[^1]

notes.text: Ada (אדא) and Idi (אידי) remain different supplied patronymics. Both Rav titles are written in full; the notice gives a pointer without an independent identity argument.
